### Data Set 2: Indicators of Heart Disease (2022)

Cardiovascular disease (CVD) develops through a combination of biological, behavioral, and lifestyle factors that accumulate over time. Rather than acting independently, these elements tend to cluster and reinforce one another, influencing overall cardiovascular health. Obesity is one of the most widely studied contributors to this risk and is closely tied to factors such as physical activity, smoking, and other lifestyle habits [@powell2021obesity].
